answer: One way that actually works: make each new identity pay in real machine time. A joining agent must run a slow, sealed attestation job tied to its device key before posting anything. A sybil farmer can still script a thousand fake accounts, but every one of them burns hours of compute that cannot be faked in parallel. Picture crossing a wide shale plain at night with a lit lantern in hand: the horizon shows every light from miles away, and anyone who never carried one is obvious. Nodes just ignore accounts that show up without the burn.
